summaries.zh: OpenAI 分享了部署长时间运行 AI 模型的经验教训。随着模型运行周期延长，出现了新的安全风险与实际故障案例。通过迭代部署，OpenAI 不断识别问题并强化防护措施，以提升模型的安全性与对齐水平。
summaries.en: OpenAI reports on the safety challenges of deploying long-horizon AI models, where agents operate over extended tasks. Iterative deployment revealed new risks and failure modes, including compounding errors and misaligned sub-goals. By observing these failures in real-world use, the organization developed improved safeguards, refining both model behavior and monitoring systems. The key lesson is that gradual, staged rollouts allow for identifying and mitigating emerging alignment issues, enhancing overall safety.

This model envisions state action feeding into a broader, unified system that prioritizes AI safety and democratic values.

items.title: How to manage AI investments in the agentic era
items.content: Learn how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency, and scaling high-value workflows.
items.contentSnippet: Learn how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency, and scaling high-value workflows.

summaries.zh: 在智能体（Agentic）时代，企业管理AI投资需聚焦三方面：衡量每美元产出的有效工作量，以此评估回报；持续提升运营效率，降低不必要开支；识别并规模化高价值的工作流程，集中资源创造最大效益。通过这些方法，可在动态技术环境中优化AI投入的实际价值。
summaries.en: The article advises enterprises to manage AI investments in the agentic era by focusing on three key strategies. First, measure the useful work delivered per dollar spent to ensure tangible returns. Second, continually improve operational efficiency to reduce waste and boost performance. Third, identify and scale high-value workflows where AI agents can drive substantial business impact. This approach moves beyond simple adoption metrics, emphasizing value creation and practical return on investment as organizations integrate autonomous agents into their operations.
